name: line-header-ends-at-markdown-heading
description: With line_headers on, "Knowledge :" (case-insensitive, spaces allowed before the colon) starts a block, which ends before the next markdown heading "## Tone". The block text excludes the header line; the block span is removed from system_instructions, and the heading and its text stay.

messages.content:
Knowledge :
The office is closed on public holidays.
## Tone
Be polite.
Are you open on New Year's Day?

items.text: The office is closed on public holidays.

expected.user_request: Are you open on New Year's Day?
